acceptanceCriteria: A replay over the last 100 PRs and pushes shows no SKIP on a run whose full job failed.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. artifact-integrity costs 9.3 min on every run including docs-only PRs and reuse pushes. corvint affected should evaluate declared per-job input sets (e.g. artifact-integrity: go.mod, go.sum, cmd/**, internal/**, Makefile, script/go-archive-gate; go-interop: interop/**, protocol/**) and emit RUN/SKIP with witnesses; unknown or parse failure gives RUN. Needs an AFP-V0-013 amendment.
title: affected: job-level input predicates for non-test CI jobs (archive, interop, intake)
